title: urnetwork / subscriptions
description: Authenticated, privacy-safe payment and subscriber operations (paid subscriptions and free trials). One fleet-wide Taskworker refreshes a complete aggregate snapshot every 15 minutes; every business panel selects one snapshot and goes no-data after 20 minutes instead of turning missing or stale telemetry into zero. Store and window are closed label sets, and no customer, purchase, invoice, transaction, network, user, or client identifier enters Prometheus.

options.content:
**Subscriptions** come from durable supporter renewal windows for Apple, Google Play / Android (`google`), Stripe, Solana, Monero, Zcash, TAO (`bittensor`), Bitcoin, ETH (`ethereum`) and Pay with Gamma (`gamma`). A free trial is a subscription (owner decision 2026-11-08): a network counts while it is paid, inside a free trial, or inside a grace period after a failed charge (a store's billing grace; the 30-day manual-payment grace of a period paid through Stripe, the crypto rails or gamma; or, since 2026-11-13, the day after a Stripe free trial whose first charge failed). App Store sandbox purchases (TestFlight, App Review) record no revenue and are left out. Per-store counts are distinct networks in that store; `deduplicated` counts a network once across all tracked stores. **Current trials** are the networks inside a free trial now, nothing charged yet, by store and plan; they are part of the current subscriptions, not added to them. Google Play and Stripe sell the trial only with the yearly plan; the App Store product names its plan. **New subscriptions** count a network's first supporter window per store, a trial's start included, while `deduplicated` is its first-ever window across all tracked stores; a trial's first charge, renewals and store switches never count again. **Engaged** means a current subscriber has at least one active top-level client whose latest authentication falls inside the selected rolling window; it is subscriber engagement, not an all-network traffic proxy. **Observed churn** means the latest known supporter window ended during the window and the account remains inactive; it combines natural expiry, cancellation and a trial that ended without a charge, because the durable renewal ledger cannot distinguish them. Reactivated accounts are excluded. **Past due** counts the current subscribers whose window has outlived the period it paid for: the grace after a failed or cancelled renewal, a store's billing grace hold, or the day after a free trial; they are part of the current subscriptions, not added to them. **Payment failures** are Stripe's failed renewals, the ones the server sends payment notices for: those still failing now, and those that stopped failing inside the window, by reason (`paid`, `voided`, `uncollectible`, or `subscription_ended` when Stripe's final action canceled the subscription). No panel here shows revenue.

Reconciliation panels count non-dry-run audit events. They require a fresh hourly run heartbeat and a fresh successful watermark for the matching store, so an unavailable provider source renders no-data rather than false zero. Gamma has no reconciliation leg, so it never has rows there. Data-pack panels are gross fulfilled grants: code-backed rows plus direct paid non-Pro balances, with a redeemed code's balance excluded from the direct side. The existing ledgers do not retain a reliable processor/product/quantity dimension for every grant; refunds and terminal provider events remain visible separately. All panels use one complete 15-minute Taskworker snapshot and export only bounded aggregate labels.

panels.title: snapshot age
panels.description: Age of the newest complete fleet-wide Taskworker snapshot. It disappears after 20 minutes or when its clock is more than 30 seconds in the future.

targets.expr: time() - topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30))

panels.title: current subscriptions (paid and trial)
panels.description: Distinct networks with a current tracked-store supporter window, deduplicated across Apple, Google Play / Android, Stripe, Solana, Monero, Zcash, TAO, Bitcoin, ETH and gamma: paid, inside a free trial, or inside a grace period after a failed charge. App Store sandbox purchases are left out.

targets.expr: max(urnetwork_subscription_active_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="deduplicated"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: new subscriptions (trial starts included)
panels.description: Distinct networks whose first tracked-store supporter window began in the selected rolling window. A free trial's start is a new subscription; its later first charge does not count again.

targets.expr: max(urnetwork_subscription_new_paid_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="deduplicated",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: engaged subscribers
panels.description: Current subscribers, trials included, with an active top-level client authentication inside the selected rolling window, deduplicated across stores.

targets.expr: max(urnetwork_subscription_engaged_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="deduplicated",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: current subscriptions by store
panels.description: Distinct networks with a current subscription in each store: paid, inside a free trial, or inside a grace period after a failed charge. A network billed by more than one store appears once in each relevant store; use current subscriptions above for the deduplicated total.

targets.expr: max by (store) (urnetwork_subscription_active_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: subscriber engagement by store
panels.description: Distinct current subscribers, trials included, with an active top-level client authentication inside the selected rolling window. `deduplicated` counts each subscriber once across stores.

targets.expr: max by (store) (urnetwork_subscription_engaged_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma|deduplicated",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: new subscriptions by store
panels.description: Distinct networks whose first supporter window in each store began inside the selected rolling window, a free trial's start included. A later switch to a new store appears once for that destination store but never inflates the separate first-ever deduplicated total above; a trial's first charge and repeated renewals in one store count once.

targets.expr: max by (store) (urnetwork_subscription_new_paid_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: current trials
panels.description: Distinct networks inside a free trial now, nothing charged yet, deduplicated across stores. They are part of the current subscriptions, not added to them.

targets.expr: sum(urnetwork_subscription_trials_active{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="deduplicated"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: current trials by store and plan
panels.description: Distinct networks inside a free trial now, by store and plan. Google Play counts the 14-day trial and the days Play adds before its first charge; Stripe counts the trial's $0 invoice period; the App Store counts a free transaction that is not a sandbox purchase. Google Play and Stripe sell the trial only with the yearly plan. The crypto markets (Solana, Monero, Zcash, TAO, Bitcoin, ETH) and gamma sell no trial.

targets.expr: max by (store, plan) (urnetwork_subscription_trials_active{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe",plan=~"yearly|monthly|unknown"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: observed churn: expiry or cancellation
panels.description: Latest tracked supporter window ended in the selected rolling window and remains inactive. Store series are network-store pairs; `deduplicated` excludes a network that remains subscribed through another tracked store. This deliberately combines natural expiry, cancellation and a free trial that ended without a charge.

targets.expr: max by (store) (urnetwork_subscription_churned_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma|deduplicated",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

options.content: **Raw cancellation intent is not durably available.** Store cancellation requests either change provider state or send the user to provider account management; the server does not retain one complete cross-store cancellation-intent ledger. Therefore this dashboard never renders an invented cancellation-intent zero. Use **observed churn** for accounts whose paid window ended and remained inactive, and **provider-confirmed terminal events** for the narrower set of ended, refunded, disputed, or revoked events recorded by reconciliation and webhooks. These sources answer different questions and must not be added together.

panels.title: provider-confirmed terminal events
panels.description: Non-dry-run ended, refunded, disputed, and revoked audit events in the selected rolling window. Requires both a reconciliation heartbeat newer than 150 minutes and the matching store's successful watermark newer than 3 hours; otherwise that store is no-data.

targets.expr: sum by (store, action) ((urnetwork_subscription_reconciliation_events{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma",action=~"ended|refunded|disputed|revoked",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30))) and on(env,service,block,host,instance) (urnetwork_subscription_reconciliation_source_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="all"} > time() - 9000) and on(env,service,block,host,instance,store) (urnetwork_subscription_reconciliation_source_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma"} > time() - 10800))

panels.title: reconciliation repairs
panels.description: Non-dry-run credits, provider-confirmed entitlement ends, and entitlement-metadata repairs recovered by the durable payment audit stream in the selected rolling window. The ended series also appears in the terminal-event view because it is both a repair and terminal evidence; the panels do not add these events together. Source freshness gates fail closed per store.

targets.expr: sum by (store, action) ((urnetwork_subscription_reconciliation_events{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma",action=~"credited|ended|entitlement_repaired",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30))) and on(env,service,block,host,instance) (urnetwork_subscription_reconciliation_source_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="all"} > time() - 9000) and on(env,service,block,host,instance,store) (urnetwork_subscription_reconciliation_source_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma"} > time() - 10800))

panels.title: reconciliation source age
panels.description: Age of the global run heartbeat (`all`) and each store's last successfully advanced watermark. This diagnostic remains visible when a source is stale, but only from the same fresh Taskworker snapshot.

targets.expr: max by (store) (time() - (urnetwork_subscription_reconciliation_source_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"all|apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30))))

panels.title: data packs fulfilled
panels.description: Gross paid data-only ledger rows in the selected rolling window. `balance_code` and `direct_balance` are disjoint: a redeemed code's balance is excluded from direct. `deduplicated` is their sum. One code row is one fulfillment even when the upstream line represented multiple units.

targets.expr: max by (source) (urnetwork_subscription_data_pack_fulfillments{env="$env",service="taskworker",source=~"balance_code|direct_balance|deduplicated",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: data-pack bytes fulfilled
panels.description: Gross bytes granted by the same deduplicated paid data-only fulfillment rows in the selected rolling window. Provider/product attribution is unavailable across all historical ledger paths.

targets.expr: max by (source) (urnetwork_subscription_data_pack_bytes{env="$env",service="taskworker",source=~"balance_code|direct_balance|deduplicated",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: all-time data-pack fulfillments
panels.description: All paid data-only fulfillment rows in the surviving ledgers, deduplicated across code-backed and direct balance paths. This is gross fulfillment, not net of refunds.

targets.expr: max(urnetwork_subscription_data_pack_fulfillments{env="$env",service="taskworker",source="deduplicated",window="all"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: all-time data-pack bytes
panels.description: Gross bytes in the same surviving deduplicated fulfillment ledgers. Refund/dispute/revocation evidence is reported in the reconciliation section rather than subtracted here.

targets.expr: max(urnetwork_subscription_data_pack_bytes{env="$env",service="taskworker",source="deduplicated",window="all"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: received payments not credited
panels.description: Payments that reached us at least 30 minutes ago and that no credit consumed, per rail: `usdc_solana` is a USDC payment into a Solana receiver that bought nothing (a `solana_unfulfilled_payment` row: the Helius webhook's, the reconcile's or its receiver leg's, which reads the receivers' own history); each crypto coin is a receipt not credited (seen, confirmed, or held for review); `gamma` is a Pay with Gamma charge spent but not credited. Each one is a customer who paid and may have no Pro. Every rail should read zero; SIGNALS.md §2.22 names the alert for each.

targets.expr: max by (rail) (urnetwork_subscription_payments_uncredited{env="$env",service="taskworker",rail=~"usdc_solana|zec|xmr|tao|btc|eth|sol|gamma"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: oldest received payment not credited
panels.description: How long the oldest payment counted in "received payments not credited" has waited, per rail that has one. A rail with nothing waiting shows no bar.

targets.expr: max by (rail) (urnetwork_subscription_payments_uncredited_oldest_age_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",rail=~"usdc_solana|zec|xmr|tao|btc|eth|sol|gamma"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: past due (in grace)
panels.description: Distinct current subscribers, deduplicated across stores, whose window has outlived the period it paid for and none of whose stores has a paid period covering now: the grace after a failed or cancelled renewal, a store's billing grace hold, or the day after a free trial. A period paid through Stripe keeps a 30-day grace after a failed renewal; a Stripe trial whose first charge failed gets a day (owner, 2026-11-13).

targets.expr: max(urnetwork_subscription_in_grace_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="deduplicated"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: past due by store
panels.description: Distinct current subscribers in each store whose windows there have all outlived the periods they paid for. A network paid in another store still counts in the store it is past due in.

targets.expr: max by (store) (urnetwork_subscription_in_grace_accounts{env="$env",service="taskworker",store=~"apple|google|stripe|solana|monero|zcash|bittensor|bitcoin|ethereum|gamma"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: open payment failures
panels.description: Stripe renewals whose charge failed and that are still failing now: no payment, void, uncollectible mark or subscription end since. Each owes the account the payment notices and shows the in-app past-due notice while its latest failure is recent.

targets.expr: max(urnetwork_subscription_payment_failures_open{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="stripe"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))

panels.title: payment failures resolved
panels.description: Failed Stripe renewals that stopped failing inside the window, by reason: paid (the customer paid or Stripe's retry succeeded), voided, uncollectible, or subscription_ended (Stripe's final action canceled the subscription, or it was canceled).

targets.expr: max by (reason) (urnetwork_subscription_payment_failures_resolved{env="$env",service="taskworker",store="stripe",reason=~"paid|voided|uncollectible|subscription_ended",window="$window"} and on(env,service,block,host,instance) topk(1, (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} > time() - 1200) and (urnetwork_subscription_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker"} <= time() + 30)))
